title: Purpose and Buyer Truth
description: Start with the buyer’s real question and define what a trustworthy answer must contain.

title: Evidence and Claim Boundaries
description: Separate fact, interpretation, framework, and promise before a claim enters a public system.

title: Canonical Entity Records
description: Give people and machines one inspectable record for who an organization is and what it actually does.

title: Autonomous Resource Management
description: Map resources, authority, trace records, and exceptions before an agent acts.

title: Trust Infrastructure
description: Make provenance, verification, reliance, and correction visible without pretending a record proves truth.

title: Machine-Readable Internet
description: Publish structured relationships and discovery files that help systems find the right record without promising ranking or retrieval.

title: Agentic Interoperability
description: Represent protocol roles, capabilities, messages, task state, and human handoffs without assuming interoperability guarantees safety.

title: Economic Models and Agentic Commerce
description: Keep value, payment, fulfillment, dispute, incentives, and risk allocation as separate states.

title: Autonomous Governance and Policy Envelopes
description: Bound decisions with policy, evaluation, change control, exceptions, appeals, and accountable human roles.

title: Offer Design and Qualification
description: Turn a real buyer problem into a specific, inspectable offer with eligibility and no invented guarantee.

title: Discovery and Buyer Research
description: Find what a buyer is deciding, what evidence they trust, and where the current answer fails them.

title: Proof Packets and Case Evidence
description: Assemble evidence that a buyer can inspect without turning an example into a promise or a testimonial.

title: Agent Sales Conversations
description: Train agents to make the useful next step clear while staying inside authorization, evidence, and truth boundaries.

title: Human Handoffs and Close
description: Close the loop by routing the right evidence and decision to the right accountable person at the right time.

title: Measurement, Correction, and Maintenance
description: Measure what actually happened, correct the record, and recheck it before stale truth becomes sales friction.

title: AURE Capstone: The Trusted Buyer Path
description: Connect all sixteen artifacts into one reviewable path from buyer question to evidence, decision, handoff, and maintained truth.
